name: freegama
description: Play Freegama's daily brain games for fun in the app browser.

interface.longDescription: Play Freegama's daily set of short brain games for fun. This entertainment plugin is for teens and adults who want a daily puzzle break. Ask to start or resume daily practice, then play the games yourself in the app's built-in browser and view your results on Freegama. The games run on the Freegama website; game controls are in the browser, not in the conversation. Browser access is required for in-app play; other clients receive a direct link. Progress is saved in that browser and is not synced by this plugin. No Freegama account or custom MCP server is required.
